title: Combining two kinds of commuter assistance

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Here is an update on the commuter allowance. You can claim a monthly bus pass by uploading the receipt to the benefits portal. Claims submitted by Friday will appear in this month's pay; later claims will go into next month's pay. Staff who drive to the satellite office can also claim a parking voucher, but only for a day they did not use a subsidised pass. Record the travel date on the voucher request. If you bought a pass covering the whole month, you can still claim parking on a day you drove instead, provided you did not travel on the pass that day. Keep the two requests separate.
turns.zh: 以下是通勤補助的新說明。您可以把月票收據上傳到福利入口網站，申請公車月票補助。最遲星期五送出的申請會列入這個月的薪資；過了星期五才送出的申請則列入下個月的薪資。開車到分部辦公室的員工也可以申請停車券，但限於當天未使用受補助月票的情況。請在停車券申請中記下通勤日期。即使您購買了整個月都有效的月票，只要某天改開車、當天沒有用月票搭車，仍可申請那天的停車券。兩項申請請分開送。
